claims.claim: `promptarena deploy adapter install agentcore` downloads the release binary for the OS/arch into ~/.promptarena/adapters/
`deploy adapter list` prints a 'user-level (<dir>):' group with promptarena-deploy-agentcore
deploy block lives under spec: with provider/config/environments
agentcore config needs region, runtime_role_arn, runtime_binary_path (validated before plan)
runtime binary built with `make build-runtime-arm64` in promptarena-deploy-agentcore, output promptkit-runtime
`deploy` commands read config.arena.yaml (the file `run` reads) unless --config is given
deploy plan output: 'Deploy plan for environment: default (provider: agentcore)', Adapter line, 'Plan: 1 to create...', '+ agent_runtime.my_first_test (...)', 'Plan saved...'
without --env the environment is 'default'
plan is saved to .promptarena/envs/default/deploy.plan
the CLI compiles a pack from the config when --pack is not given
pack id / runtime name derives from the project directory name
apply prints 'Applying deployment to environment...', 'Using saved plan.', Adapter line, per-resource lines, 'Apply complete.'
apply records the deployment in .promptarena/envs/default/deploy.state
status prints header, Status, type.name: status lines, Last deployed, Pack version, Pack checksum
destroy deletes resources, removes .promptarena/envs/default/deploy.state, prints 'Deployment destroyed.'
apply without AWS credentials fails 'apply failed: adapter error -32603: agentcore: failed to create AWS client'
deploy with no subcommand plans then applies
apply reuses the saved plan while the pack is unchanged; recompiling the same config does not change the checksum
running deploy outside the project fails with 'deploy config "config.arena.yaml" not found'
the CLI asks the adapter to validate config before planning; a missing required field stops the plan
